details: For finite binary concept classes. The equality identifies the arbitrary-target specifying-set formulation with the largest projected one-inclusion star.
proof: Hanneke--Yang's Theorem 13 proves their finite-pool identity $\mathrm{XTD}(\mathcal H,m)=\min\{\mathrm S(\mathcal H),m\}$. Taking a pool containing the finite effective range gives $\mathrm{XTD}(\mathcal H)=\mathrm S(\mathcal H)$.
